steps.text: Salve! I'm Rufus, I mended your uncle's nets. Row with the Left and Right arrow keys, or A and D, to look for fish.
Good. Now hold Space or the mouse over the water, then let go to cast your line.
A twitching float is a fish nibbling, so wait. When it goes under and your dog barks, press, quick, to strike!
Hold to reel him in, and let go when he runs. Too hard and the line snaps; too soft and he slips off.
steps.praise: Your first fish! Your uncle would have liked to see that.

steps.text: Catch a few more, then row back to the jetty with the arrow keys and go ashore to sell them.
Click the fish market to sell your catch. Sell too many of one kind and the price drops.
Each fish likes its own bait. The netmaker sells shrimp and bread too. Buy some and see who bites.
The villas post orders on the harbour board, and they pay far better than the market.
Pots fish while you do. Pick Pots, then press Space to sink one. Row over it later to lift it.
Folk are talking about you, and the rocky shore is open. Sail there from the bay map.

farewell: Mehercule, you hardly need old Rufus now. The bay is yours, my friend. Fair winds, and vale!
